derivation: E[max] = sum_k k * (F(k)^n - F(k-1)^n) for halt-step cdf F and batch size n.
empirical_corroboration: Measured early-exit speedup is 0.96-0.99x at batch 64-256 on both task families.
protocol_deviations: Assumes independent per-example halt steps; correlated difficulty within a batch would change the constants but not the direction.
scope: Applies to any per-example adaptive-compute method under static batching, including ACT, PonderNet, early-exit transformers and depth-routed mixtures of experts.
statement: Batched cost of per-example adaptive computation tracks E[max halt step over the batch], not E[halt step].
